acceptance_focus: Missing 99_MASTER_ALL, ambiguous OR/guard text, duplicate IDs, unknown operators or incompatible versions are explicit import failures, not executable guesses.
Reject userinfo tricks, private/link-local destinations, unsafe schemes and redirect escapes. Preserve meaningful path/query case.
A 200 challenge, 304 without retained body, truncated response or transport error is not complete usable HTML. Count failed attempts and redirects.
429 causes backoff, not stealth escalation. Empty shells may justify rendering. Do not cross authentication/access restrictions. Every navigation and subrequest is bounded.
Sitemap counts are declared URL counts, not verified products/jobs. Bound compressed/decompressed size and reject external entities and disallowed targets.
This deliberately supersedes the workbook's 'sitemaps only' use. Failed retrieval is handled by an explicit policy, never a business absence.
A probe is fetched once and its body reused. 404 is scoped path evidence, not missing software. Record paths skipped by budget or policy.
External ATS/portal links are retained as evidence but require a separately approved source scope before following.
A canonical tag alone cannot merge organizations or extend crawl scope. Exact accepted host scope is distinct from registrable-domain grouping.
Do not overwrite source bytes with lowercase/errors=ignore. Raw/comment matches alone cannot prove active deployment.
A script from an agency example or unbound frame must not become the site's product deployment.
Keep values carrying keys/tokens out of routine exports; arbitrary 'AI' or library text is not product proof.
Capture reference does not authorize external/private portal navigation; do not combine different tenant frames.
No form submissions. An action/reference is not a verified backend CRM connection.
Keep anchor evidence distinct from loaded scripts. Mention, login link, appointment CTA and publisher credit require different mappings.
A displayed badge is a website assertion, not independent accreditation. Do not pair separate truncated src/alt arrays.
Do not independently zip name/content arrays or collapse conflicting meta values without a record.
Malformed blocks are not silently absent. Parsed graph identity must be retained; regex hints cannot stand in for a successful parse.
A type belonging to an embedded article or third party is not the site's organization classification.
A 'powered by' or agency link may identify a site provider, not software owned or used internally by the prospect.
Use approved public interactions only for rendered controls; no login, booking, payment or other state-changing action.
Whitespace, quoting and case fixtures; fake attribute text in comments/prose does not qualify as a real node.
Fallback code is not evidence that a request executed in the rendered session.
For prose rules only; not the sole technology surface. Do not label regex tag stripping as true browser visibility.
Query values containing personal data or secrets are restricted/redacted; /jobs is a path, not a job count.
Transport observations must retain response provenance. Cookie values and secrets are not normal fingerprint exports.
No generic raw substring shortcut for hostname authority; case-sensitive paths/IDs remain case-sensitive when required.
Do not split quoted phrases or arbitrary natural-language guards on every occurrence of OR.
Prefer parsed JSON-LD and attributes. Regex compilation alone is not timeout/cost safety.
Reject notvendor.com, vendor.com.evil, vendor in path/query, and vendor.com@evil. Do not collapse a specific cdn hostname to its parent.
Do not automatically turn footer provider credits into prospect product-use facts.
Whole-page raw fallback is candidate evidence only. Displayed credential is not credential verification.
The workbook's named AND gate uses ANY among listed OR terms. Do not suppress a valid generic vendor observation when vertical qualification fails.
No schema is not a failure; wrong or unbound type is a warning/confound, not an automatic negative.
Commercial negatives neither retract facts nor count as operational DNC restrictions.
Do not concatenate into anonymous strings, cross host/subject scope, or discard duplicate rule supports. Two modes avoid the workbook ordering ambiguity.
The workbook does not specify numerical weights. Mark proposed weights uncalibrated; never use score to promote a candidate fact.
No-hit, incomplete and failed states remain distinct; write atomically/idempotently. HostResult alone cannot serve as the fact evidence store.
